title: Space
info: Our solar system has the Sun and the planets that travel around it.
Earth is the planet we live on. The Moon travels around Earth.
The Sun is a star that gives us light and heat.
There are eight planets in our solar system. They orbit the Sun.
Stars are giant balls of hot gas. Galaxies contain billions of stars.
